description: Create the shared UI foundation: install Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui, Framer Motion, and shared component library (packages/ui). Create the Counter brand design system with bold orange accent (#F97316) on dark backgrounds, warm orange gradients, Linear-inspired clean/spacious layout. Build reusable components: Button, Card, Badge, Input, Dialog, Toast (sonner), Command Palette (cmdk), Sidebar, ThemeProvider (dark/light mode), and the Counter logo SVG.
steps: Create packages/ui directory as a shared package with package.json (name: @counter/ui), tsconfig.json extending tsconfig.base.json, and tailwind config
Install Tailwind CSS v4, @tailwindcss/postcss, postcss, class-variance-authority, clsx, tailwind-merge, lucide-react as dependencies

Install shadcn/ui foundational deps: @radix-ui/react-dialog, @radix-ui/react-dropdown-menu, @radix-ui/react-popover, @radix-ui/react-slot, @radix-ui/react-tooltip, @radix-ui/react-separator, @radix-ui/react-switch, @radix-ui/react-avatar, @radix-ui/react-tabs
Install framer-motion, sonner (toast), cmdk (command palette), next-themes (dark/light mode)
Create packages/ui/src/lib/utils.ts with cn() helper using clsx + tailwind-merge

Create packages/ui/src/styles/globals.css with Tailwind directives and CSS custom properties for the Counter brand: --brand-orange: #F97316, --brand-orange-light: #FB923C, --brand-orange-dark: #EA580C, dark mode variables (background: #0A0A0F, surface: #141419, border: #23232D), and light mode equivalents
Create packages/ui/src/components/button.tsx - shadcn-style button with variants (default/orange accent, outline, ghost, destructive, link) using CVA
Create packages/ui/src/components/card.tsx - dark glass-morphism card with subtle border glow
Create packages/ui/src/components/badge.tsx - status badges with color variants
Create packages/ui/src/components/input.tsx - styled input with dark mode support
Create packages/ui/src/components/dialog.tsx - modal dialog using Radix
Create packages/ui/src/components/dropdown-menu.tsx - using Radix dropdown
Create packages/ui/src/components/tooltip.tsx - using Radix tooltip
Create packages/ui/src/components/avatar.tsx - using Radix avatar
Create packages/ui/src/components/separator.tsx - using Radix separator
Create packages/ui/src/components/tabs.tsx - using Radix tabs
Create packages/ui/src/components/switch.tsx - using Radix switch for toggles
Create packages/ui/src/components/sidebar.tsx - collapsible sidebar navigation component with sections, icons, active state, collapse toggle, and footer area for user info
Create packages/ui/src/components/command-palette.tsx - full-screen command palette using cmdk with keyboard shortcut (Cmd+K), search, grouped actions
Create packages/ui/src/components/toast.tsx - toast notification wrapper using sonner with Counter brand styling
Create packages/ui/src/components/theme-provider.tsx - next-themes based provider with system/dark/light modes, dark as default
Create packages/ui/src/components/theme-toggle.tsx - sun/moon toggle button for switching themes
Create packages/ui/src/components/breadcrumbs.tsx - breadcrumb navigation component
Create packages/ui/src/components/loading.tsx - skeleton loaders and spinner components with orange accent animation
Create packages/ui/src/components/empty-state.tsx - empty state illustration placeholder with CTA
Create packages/ui/src/components/error-state.tsx - error display with retry button
Create packages/ui/src/components/data-table.tsx - styled data table with sorting, filtering placeholder
Create packages/ui/src/components/stat-card.tsx - metric/stat display card with icon, value, label, and trend indicator

Create packages/ui/src/components/logo.tsx - Counter logo as React SVG component. Design: A bold geometric 'C' mark formed by orange gradient cubes/blocks arranged in a distinctive pattern suggesting both a counter (tally) and connectivity. Uses brand orange gradient from #F97316 to #EA580C. Exports both icon-only and full wordmark versions.
Create packages/ui/src/index.ts that re-exports all components
Update pnpm-workspace.yaml if needed (already includes packages/*)
Ensure packages/ui builds successfully with tsc
acceptance_criteria: packages/ui/package.json exists with all required dependencies
All component files export valid React components with TypeScript types
globals.css contains Counter brand design tokens for both dark and light mode
Logo component renders a distinctive SVG with orange gradient
cn() utility correctly merges Tailwind classes
The package is importable from other workspace apps via @counter/ui
verification: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && cd /root/counterX && pnpm install && pnpm build
findings: fs_write tool does not write to /root/counterX - must use bash heredocs instead. next-themes attribute prop requires Attribute type (DataAttribute | class) not generic string. Build and all tests pass cleanly.
